title: 第9章 老子就不信按不服你！……坏了，中计
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜幕低垂，山林之中不见光亮。

只留下了几个影影绰绰的婆娑倒影。

林间竹屋之内，那原始的碰撞，却是一直未停！

老丑全不惜力，就算她自身的意志再坚定，也难受如此糟蹋。

“现在，你改变主意还来得及。“

“只要你跟我求饶，我现在就可以饶了你。“

“不管你怎么想，你的身子已经被我破了，你以后就是我的人了。“

“好好跟着我，我也不会亏待你！“

她精致的面容血色全无。

只有眼神，却是仍然坚毅，死死盯着老丑，仇视不屈。

“好，好，既然你不知好歹，那么就别怪我了！“

夜璇的沉默，就是等于了回答。

老丑见她死不屈服，心里怒气中也是多了一丝惊讶。

憋着一口气，老丑施展技巧。

夜璇只是任他折辱。

却始终像块捂不热的寒冰，半个字都不肯松口。

老丑捏住她的下巴，逼她看着自己。

冷笑一声：“你宁死不求饶，你觉得自己是那贱货苏若雪的闺友不成？“

“你说，若是她知道我这个她眼里的老废物、老垃圾破了你的身，她会怎么看你？“

夜璇的眼神终于有了一丝波动。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The night falls, and there is no light in the mountains and forests.

Only a few shadowy and whirling reflections were left.

In the bamboo house in the forest, the primitive collision never stops!

Lao Chou spared no effort, no matter how strong her own will was, she couldn't bear to be so ruined.

"Now, it's not too late for you to change your mind."

"As long as you beg me for mercy, I can spare you now."

"No matter what you think, your body has been broken by me, and you will be mine from now on."

"Follow me well and I won't treat you badly!"

Her delicate face was completely drained of color.

Only his eyes were still firm, staring at the old man with unyielding hatred.

"Okay, okay, since you don't know what's good or bad, then don't blame me!"

Ye Xuan's silence was tantamount to an answer.

Seeing that she refused to give in, the old Chou felt a little surprised in his anger.

Holding his breath, Lao Chou used his skills.

Ye Xuan just let him humiliate her.

But he was always like a piece of ice that could not hold any heat, refusing to let go of even a single word.

Lao Chou pinched her chin and forced her to look at him.

He sneered: "You would rather die than beg for mercy. Do you think you are the best friend of that bitch Su Ruoxue?"

"Tell me, what would she think of you if she knew that I, an old loser and trash in her eyes, had broken your body?"

Ye Xuan's eyes finally showed a slight fluctuation.
